description: This 11 km round trip trail gains 1100m of elevation as it switchbacks up to the Lost Mountain summit. The hike is steady and uneventful while climbing thought the trees, but eventually pops out on the ridge that you will continue on until you reach the summit. This hike offers scenery off the Kootenay Pass and distant mountain ranges.
directions: From Salmo head east on Highway 3 towards Creston, in 27km you will see a massive pullout just after the avalanche gates of the Kootenay Pass. You will see a kiosk in the pullout, park here and look for the trail that is located on the other side of the highway. Please cross the highway with care.
title: Lost Mtn Trail
